description: Compare Site A against Site B on page existence, content and visual regression. Charged upfront. Paid in USDC (the 402 challenge names the network), or from a prepaid balance when the request carries Authorization: Bearer dck_…: 0.02 USD per page for the first 1000 pages and 0.01 USD per page beyond. One single-page comparison per client address per day is free without a payment credential or prepaid key; sample report: https://difficat.com/agents/sample/report.json. dryRun: true answers the page count and exact amount without charging or starting a job. maxPriceUsd refuses a job priced above it before any challenge. A settled charge is final: cancelling, a failed job or partial results do not reduce it. Then wait_for_comparison holds until the job ends; its summary.issuesBySeverity is the verdict, and get_report with failedOnly: true lists the failed pages. Answers with jobId, jobToken, status and pagesCharged, plus sample on the free run.

callbackUrl.description: Optional https URL (port 443) that receives one JSON POST when the job ends (jobId, status, summary, links; never the jobToken), a nudge to read the job. Public hosts only, no redirects followed, retried twice; delivery never affects the job.

checkMode.description: What each page is checked on: full (existence, content and visual, the default) or text-only (existence and content, no screenshots).

dryRun.description: Quote only: runs every check and the pricing, then answers the page count and exact amount. Nothing is charged, the free sample is not used and no job starts; the same body without dryRun is priced from the retained result.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional opaque string a retry repeats: under a prepaid key the same value within 24 hours is not charged again and answers DUPLICATE_REQUEST with the jobId of the first call.

maxPages.description: Optional ceiling on the pages compared and charged for. The job is priced on the pages it compares: the urls list, or the pages discovery finds, at most this many. There is no page limit.

maxPriceUsd.description: Optional spend cap in USD. A job priced above it is refused before any challenge, so an auto-paying client is never asked for more.

sourceAuth.description: HTTP basic auth for Site A.

sourceUrl.description: Site A, the reference site (full URL). Required unless urls is given.

targetAuth.description: HTTP basic auth for Site B.

targetUrl.description: Site B, the migrated site. Omit to capture screenshots of Site A only.

threshold.description: Visual diff tolerance as a fraction from 0 (exact) to 1: 0.05 means 5%. The web app takes a percentage; the API does not.

urls.description: Explicit page pairs to compare (at most 50000); skips discovery and is priced per pair. One pair is a single-page comparison and needs no sourceUrl.

target.description: The same page's URL on Site B.
